speaker: Liora
text: My whole life I've poured into other people's fire. First one at Vael who ever noticed the cost was a commoner who's scared of his own hands.

speaker: Kai
text: Not scared anymore. Someone kept grabbing my hand and shoving it into the fire until I stopped.

speaker: Liora
text: Ha! And she'd do it again, too.

speaker: Kai
text: Liora. Whatever this power turns out to be — I'm glad it's you standing next to it.
